text:
Type: sliding-top storage coffee table
Use: holding drinks and hidden storage in front of a sofa; living room
Style: modern, mid-century modern, minimalist
Materials: walnut veneer wood, black metal sled legs
Colors: warm medium walnut brown, black
Shape: thick low rectangular block top split into two sliding panels, slim black sled-style metal legs, clean edges, low and sleek
Feel: clean, warm, streamlined
Goes with: grey or cream sofas, black accents, white walls, wool rugs; modern or mid-century living rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Sliding-Top Coffee Table, 47"W
product.description: A light wood-patterned top slides away to reveal extra storage in this modern coffee table. Avoid mess and keep needed items close at hand. Strong metal legs give support. The natural coloring means that this item will match most color schemes, making it a must-have in any casual living space. 47"W x 24"D x 13"H MDF and metal The wood finish will match any decor. Sliding top Assemble in 15-30 minutes Clean with a soft cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
